scenarios.name: update-customer-11-vsam-only
scenarios.why: customer 11 is on KSDSCUST (ksdscust-vsam-only.txt, appended) but not in Db2's CUSTOMER: the UPDATE is +100 (l.173 true), CA-RETURN-CODE '01', no '90' and no WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE; LGUCVS01 is still LINKed and its READ UPDATE / REWRITE of customer 11 are NORMAL -- the two stores out of step, as GenApp's design allows

notes: GenApp's update-customer service (LGUCDB01, LINKed with the LGCMAREA COMMAREA, described by its caller LGUCUS01's record): UPDATE CUSTOMER sets every column from the COMMAREA by customer number, then LGUCVS01 (run in the same task) rewrites the VSAM copy. A customer that does not exist (+100, '01') leads LGUCVS01 to LINK LGSTSQ (oracle_assumptions.md X6): not here. A customer on KSDSCUST but not in Db2 (customer 11, ksdscust-vsam-only.txt) is the one +100 that does not reach LGSTSQ: LGUCVS01 finds the record.
